scope: Replay the historical pre-fix Unit writer reproducer and frozen final8 runtime oracles. The original AST13 program is preserved, not relabeled as replayed.

decisions.managed: EmitReturnIfReadFailed returns i32 process status only for entry. Ordinary functions use canonical runtime process exit1 then unreachable, regardless of Unit/scalar/product return ABI. RuntimeWriteScalar requests process declarations.
decisions.slg: Generic scalar emitFileCall delegates to void sollang_binary_write. Binary open/write/close/readers all use sollang_binary_failure; that noreturn helper emits ExitProcess(1) or exit(1) plus unreachable, independent of the source function return ABI.
decisions.preserved: Result-returning file APIs retain their Result contract. Legacy openWriter and writeInt main-only restrictions remain separate controls.
